raw_posts.name: Jockey by TwelveLabs
raw_posts.tagline: Your entire video library: organized, searchable, understood
raw_posts.description: Jockey is the first AI that understands your entire media library across photos and video. It analyzes thousands of hours of footage so you can find and connect people, moments and context across videos. Use it in Claude or ChatGPT, or build with the API/SDK. Ingest YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Reels links; assemble content into MP4s; and create and share video-driven artifacts with playable clips. Every TwelveLabs model upgrade makes Jockey better, without re-integration.

raw_posts.name: Harness by Autonomous
raw_posts.tagline: Every coding agent, every machine, one command center.
raw_posts.description: Harness is the open-source command center for coding agents. Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud: every agent on every machine, side by side. Use the native desktop app, hn in your terminal, or the iOS and Android app to answer agents by voice. End-to-end encrypted. Then go beyond code with 49 harnesses for CAD, circuits, robots, games and music. Free on Mac and Linux.

raw_posts.name: Tesla Roadster
raw_posts.description: Roadster can perform at levels unlike any other production car. It goes beyond Plaid to unlock an entirely new dimension of driving. It challenges the limits of design, engineering and physics to deliver an expertly crafted extra-terrestrial vehicle.

raw_posts.name: SignWith
raw_posts.tagline: E-signatures without the subscription. Pay per doc.
raw_posts.description: Sign 3 documents free every month, then buy one-time credit packs from $9. Every account gets signing order, email OTP verification, audit trail and certificate of completion. Send from the app, the API, or AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT using the MCP.

raw_posts.name: Pomerado
raw_posts.tagline: Turn any website into an API; Faster & reliable browser use
raw_posts.description: Pomerado turns any website into a MCP / API in minutes. Automate everything by turning previously inaccessible websites (like Google Flights, Zillow, Instacart, legacy portals) into native tools for your agents. Our open-source tool builds, hosts, authenticates, and maintains your integrations, so you can focus on building.

raw_posts.name: Hintly for Google Meet™
raw_posts.tagline: Real-time hints for every term you miss on Google Meet
raw_posts.description: Hintly explains the terms, names and things people mention on your Google Meet calls, a moment after they come up.

raw_posts.name: Fish Audio Drama 3
raw_posts.tagline: AI voice acting you can direct, not just generate
raw_posts.description: Drama 3 is Fish Audio's latest AI voice model, built for performances you can direct. Turn scripts into expressive speech with natural-language control over emotion, pacing, whispers, laughter, and pauses — even within a single sentence. Create multi-character scenes, audiobooks, game dialogue, and narration across 83 languages. Available on the web, mobile, and API, with open weights for self-hosting under Fish Audio's community license.

raw_posts.name: Memory Chess
raw_posts.tagline: Study a chess position, then rebuild it from memory
raw_posts.description: Memory Chess shows you a chess position for a few seconds, clears the board, and you put the pieces back. Version 2.0 is our biggest update yet: a daily board everyone plays once, a skill rating that moves both ways, a dashboard of your memory span and progress, shareable round replays, and a redesign in 24 languages. Free, no account. Come say hi and swap scores with other players on Telegram: t.me/TheMemoryChess

raw_posts.name: Dottr
raw_posts.tagline: Agent that drafts contracts, flags risks + gets them signed
raw_posts.description: Dottr is an AI teammate for contracts that lives in your email. Forward a thread or notes and it drafts the agreement from your templates, reviews risks in plain English, sends it for signature, and chases every signer until it’s done. Signers need no login. It also remembers the terms and dates so you can ask what you agreed later. From draft to signed instantly, so the yes doesn’t go cold.

raw_posts.name: Lovable Growth Tools
raw_posts.tagline: From building your app to growing it, in one chat
raw_posts.description: Lovable can now help you grow your business. Set a goal like “my first 100 signups” and get a launch playbook built from your app. Launch ads to Google Search, YouTube, Maps, Facebook and Instagram. Get found in Google and AI search with Semrush data. Create images, video and copy from your builds. Unlike an agency or a pile of tools, it lives next to your app and traffic, and you approve before anything spends.
